parameters.content:
## Lokalise key trace (inputs, READ ONLY)

POST JSON to the **Trace request** webhook (path `lokalise-key-trace`).
Body: `project_id` (required), `key_filter` (default `&filter_untranslated=1`), `added_on` (YYYY-MM-DD), `pages` (number, default 1), `repos` (string[], default ["pdfhelp-monorepo"]), `branch_regex` (optional).

Responds with the **Trace** node JSON: ticket_keys, commits, unmatched_keys. Only reads Lokalise and GitHub. Via n8n MCP: execute_workflow, manual mode, triggerNodeName "Trace request", inputs.webhookData.body = the JSON above.

**Auth is off in this draft.** Before publishing, create a dedicated Header Auth credential and select it on the webhook. Do not reuse a Lokalise token.
